scope: Extends the merged M3 suppression-label checker (PR #62, PROP-P3-M3-SUPPRESSION-LABELS-01, not yet in Toledo) with the orthogonal-turn generation-1 chain as an EXACT FIXTURE / FINITE DIAGNOSTIC, closing the calibration item left open by PR #62. Registered web: the time-honest gen-1 web +-p0, +-q0, +-p1, +-q1 with p0 = (1,0,0), q0 = (2,4,0), p1 = (3,4,0), q1 = (6,8,20); polarizations T0 = (0,1,0), N0 = (0,0,1), N0, N1 = (4,-3,0)/5 fixed by the selected chain (axis exchange T1 = N0); real H1-flat amplitudes |alpha_k| = 1/|k|, exact over Q(sqrt5); declared cell |t|^2 <= 500 = |q1|^2. Provenance: generator script ot_chain_gen1_timehonest.py (polarization chain also in ot_chain_gen1_fullconv.py) of the internal attack repository at commit 83d8b5bf0ed15ab81033e0ce92af6e80c9596c95; public wavevector/turn geometry as certified by check_ns_p2_orthogonal_turn_allscale_escape.py. Founder-required assertions are executed by the checker: k.u_k = 0 for every mode; every amplitude entry algebraic with no floating-point atoms; the interaction is symbolically the same Fourier-Leray operator B(p,q,a,b) = P_{p+q}[(a.q) b + (b.p) a] as the other checkers. Exact result: 32 targets, SUPPRESSED 12, NOVELTY 20, UNRESOLVED 0; labels O12/E8/C0/T2; N_{O,1}/N_{O,>=2} = 12/0; every target single-source so C cannot occur; selected channels p1 and p2 are NOVELTY; tree-return p0 is {O}; labels identical under the generator's critical normalization. The five-mode complex-phase variant is not registered (real web contract). This is a finite diagnostic of the four-label interface on one exact web; it is never evidence that RSC (O/E/C) passes globally, that the chain is compact or zero-novelty, or anything about OCSR, Witness Soundness, G6/G7, or Clay Navier-Stokes regularity, all of which remain OPEN. W1/W2/W3 results and all prior statements unchanged; no global P2 claim is promoted; C remains an accounting label, never a physical loss.
